question.text: In the DPE composite scoring system for PSU performance, which indicator carries the highest weightage?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Series IX page 220, the DPE composite score for PSU performance lists Net Profit to Net Worth at a weightage of 25, which is the highest among the listed indicators. Inter Sectoral Performance follows at 20. The Trap: Inter Sectoral Performance at 20 is the second-highest weightage and is easy to misrank. PBDIT to Capital Employed and the remaining indicators carry lower weightages on the page 220 table. Note: Refer directly to the DPE indicator weightage table on page 220 to confirm Net Profit to Net Worth as the top-weighted indicator.
